description.value: Bridgemans is a family of bistro-style restaurants tied to marinas in the Mill Bay and North Pender Island areas, operated under the Mill Bay Marine Group. The concept pays homage to hard-working blue-collar culture, offering imaginative comfort-food dishes and drinks in waterfront settings. A touring cyclist passing through either Mill Bay or Pender Island would find a sit-down meal experience with a local, community-oriented feel.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bridgemans is an active restaurant group with two locations: Mill Bay (740 Handy Road) and North Pender Island (Port Browning Marina). However, the OSM address '17110 Parkinson Road' does not match either website location, and the OSM coordinates (48.5559, -124.4145) place the node on the west coast of Vancouver Island near Port Renfrew — inconsistent with both known Bridgemans locations. No cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
